correctness.rationale: Submitted proof on D_{2,n} for every n>=6 uses leaf permutation averaging, right-leaf difference eigenvalue b=(n-2)/D, explicit Rayleigh witness and positive dual coefficients against separate hub capacity inequalities, then a four-orbit characteristic polynomial to bound every negative mode; algebra is consistent. Independent Laplacian matrix spectra for n=6,7,10,20 give the claimed SLEM and n=6 eigenvalues including lambda2=1/10. Critically, the complete theorem is also a specialization p=2,q=n of two earlier proven general double-star classifications, checked by exact substitution and not solely numerical agreement.
